solutionSql:
SELECT id, origin_id, distance_km
FROM routes
WHERE origin_id IN (1, 2)
  AND distance_km > 300
ORDER BY distance_km DESC, id ASC;
notes: Routes 1 and 5 are both 1 to 2, and routes 2 and 6 are both 2 to 3, so the lanes are duplicated. Only routes 2 and 6 pass the distance filter. The ticket is explicit about the filters and the sort.
